title: Work section scrolls smoothly in Chromium
done_when: Playwright Chromium trace while scrolling through #work: average FPS >= 55, no long task > 100 ms after first paint; SWork.tick() cost per frame < 4 ms in a CPU profile

title: Work section stable in WebKit (Safari proxy)
done_when: Playwright WebKit: scroll top-to-bottom through #work 3 times; layout screenshots at 25/50/75/100% match Chromium within tolerance; no stuck scroll, no console errors

title: Core Web Vitals in budget
done_when: Lighthouse on production build (astro preview): mobile Performance >= 85, desktop >= 95; LCP < 2.5 s, CLS < 0.1, TBT < 200 ms

title: Zero runtime errors
done_when: Load + full scroll in Chromium and WebKit: 0 console errors, 0 failed network requests, 0 404 assets

title: Accessibility baseline
done_when: axe-core on rendered page: 0 critical/serious violations; Lighthouse Accessibility >= 95; keyboard can reach every link

title: Build and types clean
done_when: init.sh exits 0: npm run build succeeds, astro check reports 0 errors

title: Repository hygiene
done_when: node_modules, .astro, dist, .DS_Store untracked and ignored; git ls-files | wc -l < 200; working tree clean after commit

title: Owner's real works placed in Work section
done_when: User-supplied works (video/image + title + link) render in SWork; design approved by user in own browser; 21st.dev components used only where they fit

title: Preview reachable for the owner
done_when: astro preview served on tailscale0 via tailscale serve, URL logged in claude-progress.txt, survives laptop sleep (runs in tmux on VPS)

title: Risky visual perf changes on branch audit/visual-risky
done_when: Branch audit/visual-risky has separate commits for: will-change reduction, mix-blend-mode overlay replacement, clip-path simplification, canvas point-grid density; each commit has before/after screenshots (desktop+mobile, Chromium+WebKit) and FPS numbers in audit/out/risky/; branch pushed; user picks what to merge

title: Work section style prototypes
done_when: 2-3 style variants of the Work section built in works-only-project on branches proto/work-a, proto/work-b, proto/work-c using current Pen videos as placeholders; each has desktop+mobile screenshots in audit/out/proto/ and a 5-line rationale in claude-progress.txt; branches pushed; user picks a direction
